YinYang Street: Separate Ways, as the spin-off of YinYang Street Ultimate Edition, completes the story through Duan Lifang’s eyes. Duan Lifang, a woman from Bai minority, is an ordinary employee at the Spring City Textile Mill. One day, her husband returns home on leave. After a long separation, the couple decides to go to the nearby cinema to watch a film called Flower on the Plateau. However, this dreamlike romantic date unexpectedly triggers a series of bizarre and inexplicable events...
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
